name: Grumpy Scampi
storyline: Scampi is grumpy, and the octopus has far too much power in its tentacle. One whack sends him flying – how high he gets is up to the player.
summary: Grumpy Scampi is a 2D vertical platformer for iOS and Android. An octopus launches a grumpy scampi with a timed strike, and the player steers him upwards through the sea by bouncing off friendly sea creatures such as jellyfish, clams, dolphins and turtles, stomping on crabs and avoiding hazards. The game has six worlds with their own mechanics (darkness in the deep sea, slippery ice floes, cannonballs, bubble vents and blinking Christmas tree worms), 60 levels with bonus goals and up to three stars, an endless mode per world, five minigames, cosmetic skins and accessories, achievements, seasonal events and a season pass. Online leaderboards and a friends chat are optional. The game is free to play with optional in-app purchases and contains no ads.
